culture_religion_events.1.a.en: It is time young [target_heir.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] learned [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] customs.

culture_religion_events.1.desc.en: During [target_heir.GetHerHis] education, [target_heir.GetName] has grown attached to our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCabinetMemberTitle], [teacher.GetName], forming a special bond both with [teacher.GetHerHim] and to the [teacher.GetCulture.GetName] people of [teacher.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip]'s homeland.\n\n[target_heir.GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s tours to [teacher.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] communities in our lands have done wonders for the popularity of our dynasty, but have also raised many eyebrows in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName]. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] are starting to worry that [target_heir.GetNameWithNoTooltip] will favor [teacher.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] subjects when [target_heir.GetSheHe] takes the reigns of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank] and have begun to plot against [target_heir.GetHerHim] and [teacher.GetNameWithNoTooltip] at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle|U]. They demand that we chastise the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetHeirTitle] and guarantee the rights of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')].

culture_religion_events.10.a.en: We must listen to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')] of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank].

culture_religion_events.10.desc.en: A [minister.GetCulture.GetName] official, [minister.GetName]'s rise to high office has angered many of those closest to [target_ruler.GetName]. Some senior members of some of the oldest [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] families in our country have approached our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle], demanding that we relieve [minister.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] of [minister.GetHerHis] position.

culture_religion_events.11.desc.en: As a leading figure of the [minister.GetCulture.GetName] community, [minister.GetName] has both good insights and a strong influence far beyond the council which [minister.GetSheHe] is part of in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName]. A fact that [minister.GetSheHe] has used to our advantage, significantly raising popular support for both our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank] and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] people who rule it.

culture_religion_events.12.a.en: One day you might all rise to be like [minister.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

culture_religion_events.12.a.tt.en: Our [pops|e] that follow the [minister.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [religion|e] will gain [ShowNamedValue('pop_satisfaction_mild_bonus')|+=2%] [pop_satisfaction|e]
culture_religion_events.12.a.tt.uk: Our [Concept('pops','населення')|e] that follow the [minister.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [Concept('religion','віра')|e] will gain [ShowNamedValue('pop_satisfaction_mild_bonus')|+=2%] [pop_satisfaction|e]

culture_religion_events.12.desc.en: The [minister.GetReligion.GetAdjective] faithful have watched the rise of our [minister.GetName] with both interest and enthusiasm. To many, [minister.GetSheHe] has become proof that it is possible for someone to do well within the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state despite not belonging to the state religion.

culture_religion_events.13.a.en: It is time we let [minister.GetNameWithNoTooltip] go.

culture_religion_events.13.b.en: We do not bow to the demands of petty dilettantes.

culture_religion_events.13.b.tt.en: All [countries|e] of our Religion Group gain a [ShowBiasValue('entertaining_heathens')|+=] [opinion|e] of us.
culture_religion_events.13.b.tt.uk: Усі [Concept('countries','держави')|e] нашої релігійної групи отримують [ShowBiasValue('entertaining_heathens')|+=] [opinion|e] про нас.

culture_religion_events.13.desc.en: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] have long objected to our use of heathens in high positions. When [minister.GetName] was appointed to our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCabinetTitle], they objected loudly, and their objections have not grown any less adamant over time. Some leading religious scholars, both at home and abroad, are now denouncing the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank] for its blatant favoritism of non-[ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetGroup.GetAdjective] officials.

culture_religion_events.14.a.en: It is time we let [minister.GetNameWithNoTooltip] go.

culture_religion_events.14.desc.en: Many of our faithful [ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetAdjective] subjects of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] see [minister.GetName] as a threat to the theological purity of the government. It is feared that through [minister.GetHerHis] influence, [target_ruler.GetName] will be convinced to favor the [minister.GetReligion.GetAdjective] officials in government or indeed that [minister.GetSheHe] might turn the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] [target_ruler.GetHerselfHimself] away from the true faith.

culture_religion_events.18.a.en: It is time to have a talk with [target_heir.GetNameWithNoTooltip]

culture_religion_events.18.b.en: It is the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] who rules this country.

culture_religion_events.18.desc.en: [target_heir.GetName] has taken a strong interest in [target_religion.GetAdjective] teachings. As the Heir-Apparent, [target_heir.GetSheHe] is of course expected to know all our subjects, but perhaps not to the extent of discussing theology and hosting debates [target_heir.GetHerselfHimself] on [target_religion.GetName]. Leading members of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] have now approached [target_ruler.GetName] to voice their concerns. They do not foresee a future for our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetHeirTitle] in high government if we do not force [target_heir.GetHerHim] to come to [target_heir.GetHerHis] senses.

culture_religion_events.2.a.en: They will learn to love [target_ruler.GetHimHer] in time.

culture_religion_events.2.a.tt.en: All [countries|e] of [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] culture gain a [ShowBiasValue('opinion_ruler_of_our_culture')|+=] [opinion|e] of us.
culture_religion_events.2.a.tt.uk: Усі [Concept('countries','держави')|e] [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] культури, що й [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip], отримують [ShowBiasValue('opinion_ruler_of_our_culture')|+=] [opinion|e] про нас.

culture_religion_events.2.desc.en: The ascension of [target_ruler.GetName] has been very well received by [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetName] sympathizers in our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank], but many [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] locals view their new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] with some distrust. To them, [target_ruler.GetSheHe] is in many ways a [target_ruler.GetWomanMan] of strange customs and foreign mannerisms.

culture_religion_events.21.a.tt.en: A fourth of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [pops|e] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetNameWithNoTooltip] will convert to [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [religion|e].
culture_religion_events.21.a.tt.uk: Чверть нашого [ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [Concept('pops','населення')|e] у [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetNameWithNoTooltip] навернеться до [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [Concept('religion','віри')|e], яку сповідує [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

culture_religion_events.21.b.en: We could never take such a risk.

culture_religion_events.21.desc.en: For a long time now, the personal convictions of [target_ruler.GetName] have been at odds with the religious establishment of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. This has caused both friction and conflict with the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] and leading [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] who now often question [target_ruler.GetHerHis] rule. There are, however, many that now support [target_ruler.GetHerHim] in his devotion to the [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetAdjective] faith, both in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] countryside.\n\nPerhaps the time has come to make a great change to how the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameWithNoTooltip] functions to its very core? Surely the defenders of the old ways would not go out willingly, but if there is a will there is a way...

culture_religion_events.22.a.tt.en: A fourth of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] [pops|e] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetNameWithNoTooltip] will adopt [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] [culture|e].
culture_religion_events.22.a.tt.uk: Чверть нашого [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] [Concept('pops','населення')|e] у [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetNameWithNoTooltip] перейме [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] [Concept('culture','культуру')|e], яку має [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

culture_religion_events.22.b.en: We could never dishonor the legacy of our ancestors.

culture_religion_events.22.desc.en: Ever since the start of [target_ruler.GetName]'s rule, it has been clear that [target_ruler.GetHerHis] heart lies with the [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetName]. In time, the palace halls of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] have come to echo in merry celebrations held entirely in the traditional [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] manner as even the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] have taken to the strange, yet seemingly fashionable, customs of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle].\n\nWith so much support for the foriegn customs, many in our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCabinetTitle] believe it is time to codify the special status of the [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] culture in our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank].

culture_religion_events.3.a.tt.en: A tenth of our non-[ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [pops|e] in every location under 50% [control|e] will convert to [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [religion|e].
culture_religion_events.3.a.tt.uk: Десята частина нашого не-[ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [Concept('pops','населення')|e] у кожному районі з [control|e] нижче 50% навернеться до [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [Concept('religion','віри')|e], яку сповідує [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

culture_religion_events.3.desc.en: The faith of [target_ruler.GetName] has long been the cause of consternation among the leading [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank]. Over time, however, [target_ruler.GetHerHis] influence has lead to some 'new men' and even some of our older families adopting the [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetAdjective] faith. The fact that the [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] rite opens doors in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName], together with an ever-increasing visibility of [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s worship, has led to the rite spreading throughout our country, attracting new converts from within as well as from other parts of the world.

culture_religion_events.4.desc.en: Many among the righteous [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] have long been in agreement that the heretical beliefs of [target_ruler.GetName] are poisoning the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank] and are putting our people in peril.\n\nTogether with the local priests of [rebel_province.GetName], a particularly pious scion of one of our older families has assembled an army in [rebel_province.GetName] and is now marching on the capital to depose the vile heretic in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName].

culture_religion_events.5.a.en: Extensive use of force is only fitting.

culture_religion_events.5.b.en: A throne is worth converting for!

culture_religion_events.5.desc.en: The presence of an openly heathen [target_ruler.GetReligion.GetGroup.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] has not gone unnoticed among the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetReligion.GetAdjective] subjects in our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank]. Among the devout, this has come to be a common matter of irritation and in areas with existing religious tensions it has led to even greater frequency of conflicts. Local [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy')] are reported to have further inflamed the situation in [rebel_province.GetName] by repeatedly returning to the 'corruption of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetNameWithNoTooltip]' in agitating speeches to the people of [rebel_province.GetName]. At this point, it might be hard to remove them from their position without extensive use of force.

culture_religion_events.6.desc.en: While there are many who find the faith of [target_ruler.GetName] to be an affront to all that is holy, [target_ruler.GetSheHe] has made [target_ruler.GetHerHis] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] a veritable haven for [target_ruler.GetHerHis] sisters and brothers in faith. Using the contact network built this way, we can reach many that we would never have been able to attract otherwise. One of those contacts, [minister.GetName], has now come under attack by those more entrenched in the ruling establishment of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank].

culture_religion_events.7.a.en: We must try to remedy this situation.

culture_religion_events.7.desc.en: It is no secret that [target_ruler.GetName] holds the [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetName] people dear to [target_ruler.GetHerHis] heart and that [target_ruler.GetSheHe] speaks the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetLanguage.GetName] language with a distinct accent.\n\n[target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip] even surrounds [target_ruler.GetHerselfHimself] with [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] advisors and courtiers, something that has not gone unnoticed by the old [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] families in our country. [minister.GetName], an old champion of traditional [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] values, has increasingly come to be at odds with [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s policies and is now about to withdraw from the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetAdjective|U] Council.

culture_religion_events.8.b.en: We must be seen to make some amends.

culture_religion_events.8.desc.en: [target_ruler.GetName]'s blatant favoritism of [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetName] culture has not gone unnoticed among the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] people of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank]. Obstructionism is becoming ever more widespread as those that have the power to do so make their frustration with recent policies known.

culture_religion_events.9.a.en: One can never have too many friends.

culture_religion_events.9.b.en: Let us study the ways of the [advanced_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [advanced_country.GetFlavorRank].

culture_religion_events.9.desc.en: [target_ruler.GetName]'s preference for the [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetName] culture and language is seen as a bit of an eccentricity by many, but it has also opened doors for us in the wider community of [target_ruler.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] countries. [target_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip] has been doing what [target_ruler.GetSheHe] can to form closer bonds with [target_ruler.GetHerHis] compatriots.
